died.name: John Calvin
died.desc: French theologian and Protestant reformer, principal developer of Calvinism
died.last_words: Thou, Lord, bruisest me; but I am abundantly satisfied, since it is from thy hand.

died.name: Archibald Campbell, 1st Marquess of Argyll
died.last_words: I die not only a Protestant, but with a heart-hatred of popery, prelacy, and all superstition. Lord Jesus, receive me into Thy glory.

died.name: Dominique Bouhours
died.last_words: I am about to-or I am going to-die; either expression is correct.

born.name: Julia Ward Howe
born.last_words: God will help me. I am so tired.

born.name: Arnold Bennett
born.cause: to his mistress, Dorothy Cheston The 63-year-old British novelist was dining in Paris with his partner, Dorothy Cheston Bennett. He drank two glasses of tap water during the meal, scoffing at Dorothy's claims that the water in Paris was not properly treated to be safe to drink. Within two days, he contracted typhoid fever and died two months later.
